phases.name: Transcendent Origin
phases.description: The primordial level preceding material creation and the ordered cosmos.

phases.name: Divine Emanation
phases.description: The unfolding of divine realities, powers and emanations from the transcendent source.

phases.name: Cosmological Rupture
phases.description: A disruption within the higher cosmological order that marks the transition toward the emergence of an ignorant lower ruler and a distinct lower order.

phases.name: Demiurgic Order
phases.description: The emergence of the Demiurge, archons and the structures associated with the ordering of the lower cosmos.

phases.name: Material Cosmos
phases.description: The formation and ordering of the material world.
